candidates.description: This vector represents modal verbs, auxiliary markers, and common prefixes associated with future intent, possibility, or necessity in Thai text.
This vector activates frequently for common Thai script characters, syllables, and prefix morphemes.
This vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant 'ส' (So Suea) appearing at the end of various syllables and words.
These tokens represent Thai script characters, diacritics, and sub-word units, primarily functioning as components of the Thai writing system.
This feature vector activates on common Thai script characters, sub-word components, and frequent Thai morphemes.
This vector activates on common subwords, phonetic components, and abbreviations related to the letters "an" across multiple languages and scripts.
These tokens represent the letter 'K' in various cases, encodings, and linguistic contexts.
This vector activates on open parentheses, frequently preceding capitalized letters, abbreviations, or proper nouns.
This vector activates strongly for the letter "K" and common name or word fragments starting with "K" or "ke".
This vector represents shared subword components or characters frequently found in geographical names and location-related terms across multiple Asian languages.
